netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_U1 n3 U1_am 0
vam_U1_p0 n1 U1_p0 0
vam_U1_p1 0 U1_p1 0
vam_U1_p2 n2 U1_p2 0
vam_U1_p4 n2 U1_p4 0
vam_U1_p5 n4 U1_p5 0
R_U1_sup U1_p0 U1_p1 2k
C_U1_q U1_q U1_p1 100p
B_U1_s U1_p1 U1_q I = 1m*(0.5*(1+tanh(((v(U1_p0,U1_p1))/3-v(U1_p2,U1_p1))/0.02))*(1-0.5*(1+tanh((v(U1_p4,U1_p1)-2*v(U1_p0,U1_p1)/3)/0.02)))*(1-v(U1_q,U1_p1)) - 0.5*(1+tanh((v(U1_p4,U1_p1)-2*v(U1_p0,U1_p1)/3)/0.02))*v(U1_q,U1_p1) + 1.2*v(U1_q,U1_p1)*(1-v(U1_q,U1_p1))*(2*v(U1_q,U1_p1)-1))
B_U1_o U1_o U1_p1 V = v(U1_p0,U1_p1)*(0.5+0.5*tanh(12*(v(U1_q,U1_p1)-0.5)))
R_U1_out U1_o U1_am 15
B_U1_b U1_qb U1_p1 V = 1-v(U1_q,U1_p1)
S_U1 U1_p5 U1_p1 U1_qb U1_p1 SW555
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n4 1000
vam_R2 n4 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am n2 47000
vam_C1 n2 C1_am 0
C_C1 C1_am 0 1e-05
vam_R3 n3 R3_am 0
R_R3 R3_am n5 470
vam_LED1 n5 LED1_am 0
D_LED1 LED1_am 0 LED_red
.model SW555 SW(Vt=0.5 Vh=0.05 Ron=20 Roff=1e12)
.model LED_red D(IS=3.2850e-17 N=2.0 RS=2.0 EG=2.300 XTI=3 BV=5 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=10n)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 0.005 5 0 0.005
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) v(n5) i(vam_b1) i(vam_u1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_r2) i(vam_c1) i(vam_r3) i(vam_led1) i(vam_u1_p0) i(vam_u1_p1) i(vam_u1_p2) i(vam_u1_p4) i(vam_u1_p5)
quit
.endc
.end
